items.t: The Iron Ore, Grain and Coal Moving by Ship: $90,000 Across These 3 Dry Bulk Shippers Pays More Than $7,000 a Year
items.sum: Freight rates are surging, yet three dry bulk shipowners just sank up to 10% in a single week. Their dividends flex with every charter contract, and one payout has already swung from $0.35 to $1.05 a share. Which names deserve your income dollars?
